omitted_axes.reason: Issue #76 exposes application and HTTP contracts only; no user interface is in scope.

test_cases.requirement: Proposal intent binds one deeply immutable policy snapshot and matching digest.
test_cases.risk: Caller-owned nested mutation can change approval or expiry semantics after digest validation.
steps: Construct policy provenance from nested caller-owned mappings and sequences.
Attempt source, top-level and nested retained-value mutation before and after proposal creation.
Reload and recompute canonical policy digest.
expected_results: No retained semantic can change.
Snapshot, digest and persisted semantics remain consistent.
Policy-selected expiry semantics are attested.

test_cases.requirement: Invalid input and unverified m4r1 targets fail before persistence.
test_cases.risk: Spoofed authority or target claims can become durable proposal intent.
steps: Exercise the complete parameter and forbidden-field matrix.
Exercise malformed, tampered, expired, revoked, cross-Workspace and store-mismatch references.
Inspect response and counters.
expected_results: Closed 400/403/422 envelopes are exact.
Rejected requests create no proposal, decision or audit rows.
No provider write occurs.

test_cases.requirement: Authentication and Workspace authorization observably precede proposal lookup.
test_cases.risk: HTTP outcomes alone can hide an unauthorized lookup and cross-Workspace existence leak.
test_cases.seam: HTTP/application ordering seam with counting ordered proposal-lookup sentinel
prerequisites: proposal-lookup sentinel recording sequence and count
steps: Reset the lookup sentinel and call create/read/approve/reject without authentication.
Reset and repeat from the wrong Workspace.
Reset and read/decide an absent proposal as an authorized principal.
Capture authorization and lookup sequence/count for every call.
expected_results: Unauthenticated and wrong-Workspace calls perform zero proposal lookups.
Authorized calls record successful authorization before exactly one scoped lookup.
Authorized absence is 404; denied calls add no decision/audit row or provider write.

test_cases.requirement: Only currently authorized humans decide; separation of duties is policy-selected.
test_cases.risk: Model/system approval or blanket proposer inequality can corrupt authority semantics.
steps: Attempt decisions from forbidden contexts.
Approve the same actor under no-SoD and explicit-SoD policies.
Exercise the closed reject reasons and one unknown value.
expected_results: Only permitted human decisions persist.
SoD denies only when configured.
Unknown reason fails before persistence; approval grants no execution authority.

test_cases.requirement: Concurrent approve/reject has one deterministic atomic winner.
test_cases.risk: Two decisions can commit or retries can overwrite the winner.
steps: Release concurrent approve/reject against one expected revision.
Reload and retry both decisions.
expected_results: Exactly one decision/audit event persists.
Revision increments once.
Losers/repeats return the persisted winner with zero provider writes.

test_cases.requirement: PostgreSQL reconstructs every immutable provenance field and material replacement creates a new identity.
test_cases.risk: Mapping omissions, mutable rows or inherited approval can silently change approved intent.
steps: Persist, decide, restart and compare every immutable provenance/timestamp/audit field.
Attempt material and audit mutation.
Create replacements after policy, title and target changes.
expected_results: Read-back exactly matches original values and ordered audit.
Database guards reject mutation.
Each replacement has new proposal/logical IDs and no inherited decision.

test_cases.requirement: Production composition derives policy-selected expiry and each denial/stale/expiry projection survives PostgreSQL-backed restart/reload.
test_cases.risk: A fake-only clock, hard-coded lifetime or in-memory projection can masquerade as durable policy behavior.
test_cases.seam: RegistryCapabilityResolver production composition plus PostgreSQL reload per condition
steps: Create/approve through real composition and verify non-default digest-bound expiry.
For temporary execution denial, record the projection, recreate the PostgreSQL-backed composition, reload the same proposal and record it again.
Restore exact compatibility and repeat before/after restart for each capability, binding and policy mismatch.
Restore exact compatibility, advance beyond expiry and repeat before/after restart for expiry.
expected_results: expires_at equals trusted creation time plus the digest-bound policy lifetime.
Each before/after pair is identical and typed: temporary denial is approved/non-stale, material mismatch is stale, expiry is non-executable.
Decision/audit values remain unchanged and execution/reconciliation/provider-write counts remain zero.

test_cases.requirement: One canonical-json-v1 authority and a reconciled #75 integration boundary produce zero provider writes.
test_cases.risk: Duplicate canonicalizers diverge or acceptance reports an unobserved zero-write result.
test_cases.seam: module dependency inventory, counting gateway sentinel and governed verification
steps: Prove one canonical implementation and run conformance tests.
Run core tests with protocol fakes and integration tests with accepted #75 composition.
Run focused/full tests, Ruff, Compose and clean Alembic while the write sentinel is installed.
expected_results: No duplicate canonical authority remains.
Core workflow retains narrow protocol dependencies while integration uses accepted #75 seams.
Explicit create_ticket write count is zero and governed checks pass.
